$comment: Example configuration for a run that syncs to your own GitHub issues and Projects board. Copy the values you need into agentic-sdlc-config.json. Every field is described under _fields. Leave the board fields empty to run without a board.

_fields.workflowDir: Directory for the local work-item files (items and comments), relative to the directory a script runs in. Default .workflow.
_fields.github.repo: owner/repo for issues and PRs, and for the workflow server's read-only pull from GitHub. Empty means auto-detect from the git remote with gh.
_fields.github.owner: User or organization that owns the GitHub Projects v2 board.
_fields.github.projectId: Board node ID (PVT_...). Read it with: gh project view <number> --owner <owner> --format json --jq .id
_fields.github.statusFieldId: Node ID (PVTSSF_...) of the board's Status single-select field. Read it with: gh project field-list <number> --owner <owner> --format json
_fields.boardStatus: Option IDs of the Status field for backlog, ready, in-progress, in-review and done, from the same field-list output. Used only when pm.adapter is 'github' and the three board fields above are set.
_fields.modelRouting: Model used for easy, medium and hard stories.
_fields.pm.adapter: Where work items go, read by scripts/lib/pm.sh. null (the shipped default): files under workflowDir only; no GitHub issue, label or board writes. 'server': the optional workflow server's SQLite database while it is running, files under workflowDir when it is not; the server never writes to GitHub; it reads issues from github.repo on first start with an empty database and on a sync request. 'github': files under workflowDir, plus GitHub issues, comments, labels and sub-issue links, and board status when the board fields are set; written after the local files without blocking. This mutates GitHub.
_fields.workflow.*: Not supported. Earlier versions listed autoMergePlanPR, autoMergeDesignPR, skipRetro, maxParallelBuilders and maxCostPerRun here; no script or prompt read the first four, and the budget check that reads maxCostPerRun (scripts/lib/cost-budget.sh) is not called by any workflow step. Autonomous merging of design and plan PRs follows the word 'autonomous' in the start prompt, and nothing caps spend.
_fields.server: Workflow server port (0 picks one from portRange), idle shutdown in minutes, and log level.
_fields.reviewStrategy.skipPerStoryReview: Skip per-story review for stories at or under maxDifficulty that carry requireLabel.
_fields.briefing: Sources and depth for the briefing skill.
